name: app-cloud-native-root
description: Root package to run all microservices together

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix api-gateway && npm install --prefix auth-service && npm install --prefix product-service && npm install --prefix ai-service && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.start: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix api-gateway" "npm run dev --prefix auth-service" "npm run dev --prefix product-service" "npm run dev --prefix ai-service" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
